definition.title: Resolve a gift-kit handoff exception
definition.description: Calculate the implications of scoped diagnostic reports and complete correction packages, then separately record sourced authority, correction, fresh rehearsal and actual handoff.
definition.question: What must we verify or correct, and can we finish before committing these gift kits?

definition.title: Establish the required answer
definition.description: Shared installed reasoning contract; gifting meaning is supplied by the module.

definition.title: Establish the required answer
definition.responsibility: Generate interpretations from declared finite rules, retain evidence-compatible alternatives, and test stability of the required answer.
invariants: Establishment requires a nonempty admissible basis and a completed counterexample check.
Different admissible answers demonstrate underdetermination even before enumeration completes.
An empty interrupted search does not establish inconsistency.
A Boolean false answer can be established. Counts do not imply probabilities.
Results are relative to the authored finite model, submitted evidence and exact query.

caseDerivation: Basis and evidence relation IDs, columns, scalar types, keys and references come from the frozen module.relations.
Case parameters use frozen module.parameters types, defaults, bounds and enumerations.
Case queryIds select distinct frozen module.queries; evaluation settings can only lower installed finite limits.
schema.description: This describes the installed validators and supported presence-restriction paths; it is not a complete JSON Schema.

structuralSlots.description: Declare typed basis, evidence, assignment and derived relation schemas.
Declare typed case parameters, defaults and permitted bounds.
Declare bounded finite subset dimensions over submitted input relation columns.
Declare finite relational rules with stratified negation and count.
Declare consistency checks on generated interpretations.
Declare checks on submitted basis and evidence facts before enumeration.
Declare the exact required Boolean, value or set answer.
Bind domain vocabulary and report organization to declared entities and calculated values.
Declare report tables over declared relations.
State the premises and conclusion boundary reviewed by people.

caseInputs.description: State the scope of the supplied information.
Supply values within the published parameter declarations.
Supply typed facts for relations marked basis.
Supply typed facts for relations marked evidence.
Select the published questions to assess.

responsibilities: Supplied basis, evidence, assumptions and assessment checks
Case changes when comparison context is supplied
reportResponsibilities.completeReportDocument: A later report-materialization service supplies the complete renderer contract; these authoring services do not claim to implement it.

app.name: Review gift-kit records
app.description: A fictional campaign review: interpret scoped checks, compare complete corrective arrangements, and finish before the handoff cutoff.
app.source:
# Canonical Decision Lab data. Rules are data, never executable code.
format: evidence-review/1
module:
  id: review-gift-kit-resolution-evidence
  version: "3.0.0"
  title: Review gift-kit records
  description: "A fictional campaign review: interpret scoped checks, compare complete corrective arrangements, and finish before the handoff cutoff."
  question: "What corrections do these gift-kit checks establish?"
  boundary: Only the published configurations and check predictions for one exact batch and journey revision.
  assumptions: [Current scoped reports are treated as accurate under the author-declared possible outcomes., "All declared joint fault configurations remain possible until excluded by reports; none has an implied probability.", An unreadable printed code can conceal its destination. Planned corrections do not establish successful completion., "Input acceptance records a named role judgment; it does not authenticate identity or issue permission."]
  parameters:
    - id: nowMinute
      type: integer
      min: 0
      label: Review time in whole minutes from the declared origin
  relations:
    - id: expectedScope
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: field
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: string
      key: [field]
    - id: state
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: label
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: stateFault
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
        - id: fault
          type: string
      key: [state, fault]
    - id: stateCorrection
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
        - id: correction
          type: string
      key: [state, correction]
    - id: checkOutcome
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: check
          type: string
        - id: outcome
          type: string
      key: [check, outcome]
    - id: prediction
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
        - id: check
          type: string
        - id: outcome
          type: string
      key: [state, check, outcome]
    - id: correction
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: observation
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: check
          type: string
        - id: outcome
          type: string
        - id: observed
          type: integer
        - id: source
          type: string
        - id: person
          type: string
        - id: text
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: recordScope
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: field
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: string
      key: [record, field]
    - id: wrongScope
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
    - id: futureRecord
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
    - id: usedRecord
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: check
          type: string
        - id: outcome
          type: string
    - id: recordDisposition
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: disposition
          type: string
        - id: code
          type: string
        - id: reason
          type: string
    - id: stateMismatch
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: check
          type: string
        - id: outcome
          type: string
    - id: ruledOutState
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
    - id: remainingState
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
        - id: label
          type: string
    - id: possibleCorrection
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: correction
          type: string
    - id: absentCorrection
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: correction
          type: string
    - id: variableCorrection
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: correction
          type: string
    - id: requiredCorrection
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: correction
          type: string
    - id: hasRemainingState
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: value
          type: boolean
    - id: correctionsEstablished
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: value
          type: boolean
  rules:
    - id: RECORD.SCOPE.MISSING
      head:
        relation: wrongScope
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: observation
          args: ["?record", "?check", "?outcome", "?observed", "?source", "?person", "?text"]
        - relation: expectedScope
          args: ["?field", "?expected"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: recordScope
            args: ["?record", "?field", "?expected"]
    - id: RECORD.SCOPE.EXTRA
      head:
        relation: wrongScope
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: recordScope
          args: ["?record", "?field", "?value"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: expectedScope
            args: ["?field", "?value"]
    - id: RECORD.FUTURE
      head:
        relation: futureRecord
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: observation
          args: ["?record", "?check", "?outcome", "?observed", "?source", "?person", "?text"]
        - op: gt
          args:
            - "?observed"
            - parameter: nowMinute
    - id: RECORD.USED
      head:
        relation: usedRecord
        args: ["?record", "?check", "?outcome"]
      body:
        - relation: observation
          args: ["?record", "?check", "?outcome", "?observed", "?source", "?person", "?text"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: wrongScope
            args: ["?record"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: futureRecord
            args: ["?record"]
    - id: RECORD.WRONG.SCOPE.DISPOSITION
      head:
        relation: recordDisposition
        args: ["?record", ignored, wrong-scope, "The record describes a different batch, revision, device or account scope."]
      body:
        - relation: wrongScope
          args: ["?record"]
    - id: RECORD.FUTURE.DISPOSITION
      head:
        relation: recordDisposition
        args: ["?record", ignored, future-observation, The reported observation is later than the explicit review time.]
      body:
        - relation: futureRecord
          args: ["?record"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: wrongScope
            args: ["?record"]
    - id: RECORD.USED.DISPOSITION
      head:
        relation: recordDisposition
        args: ["?record", used, current-scoped-report, The report is used under the published check predictions for this exact scope.]
      body:
        - relation: usedRecord
          args: ["?record", "?check", "?outcome"]
    - id: STATE.REPORT.MISMATCH
      head:
        relation: stateMismatch
        args: ["?state", "?record", "?check", "?outcome"]
      body:
        - relation: state
          args: ["?state", "?label"]
        - relation: usedRecord
          args: ["?record", "?check", "?outcome"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: prediction
            args: ["?state", "?check", "?outcome"]
    - id: STATE.RULED.OUT
      head:
        relation: ruledOutState
        args: ["?state"]
      body:
        - relation: stateMismatch
          args: ["?state", "?record", "?check", "?outcome"]
    - id: STATE.REMAINS
      head:
        relation: remainingState
        args: ["?state", "?label"]
      body:
        - relation: state
          args: ["?state", "?label"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: ruledOutState
            args: ["?state"]
    - id: CORRECTION.POSSIBLE
      head:
        relation: possibleCorrection
        args: ["?correction"]
      body:
        - relation: remainingState
          args: ["?state", "?label"]
        - relation: stateCorrection
          args: ["?state", "?correction"]
    - id: CORRECTION.ABSENT
      head:
        relation: absentCorrection
        args: ["?correction"]
      body:
        - relation: remainingState
          args: ["?state", "?label"]
        - relation: correction
          args: ["?correction"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: stateCorrection
            args: ["?state", "?correction"]
    - id: CORRECTION.VARIES
      head:
        relation: variableCorrection
        args: ["?correction"]
      body:
        - relation: possibleCorrection
          args: ["?correction"]
        - relation: absentCorrection
          args: ["?correction"]
    - id: BASIS.NONEMPTY
      head:
        relation: hasRemainingState
        args: [true]
      body:
        - relation: remainingState
          args: ["?state", "?label"]
    - id: CORRECTIONS.ESTABLISHED
      head:
        relation: correctionsEstablished
        args: [true]
      body:
        - relation: hasRemainingState
          args: [true]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: variableCorrection
            args: ["?correction"]
    - id: CORRECTION.REQUIRED
      head:
        relation: requiredCorrection
        args: ["?correction"]
      body:
        - relation: correctionsEstablished
          args: [true]
        - relation: possibleCorrection
          args: ["?correction"]
  admission:
    - id: SCOPE.REQUIRED.0
      label: Declare the current batchId
      when: []
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: expectedScope

    - id: SCOPE.REQUIRED.1

    - id: SCOPE.REQUIRED.5

    - id: SCOPE.EXACT

definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

caseDerivation: All case parameters and keyed input rows use the frozen module.inputs types, units, bounds, keys and references; no missing-value defaults or coercion are inferred.
Finite choices draw only from input arrays, input table columns or fixed literal domains; the same assignment applies to every scenario.
The scenarioDomain table explicitly lists admitted joint scenarios; an empty table is an inconsistent basis rather than vacuous feasibility.
Activity graphs, constraints, mandatory obligations, resource mappings, financial mode and preference remain frozen module declarations.
Provenance describes accepted factual sources; identifying a source does not authenticate it or infer readiness.
schema.description: Installed closed typed declaration and case-admission validators; this descriptor is not a complete JSON Schema. Publication checks admission, not computed feasibility.

Declare required typed parameters and keyed relations.
Declare finite static controls from input-only domains.

app.name: Resolve a gift-kit handoff exception — complete arrangements
app.description: Compare one authored correction package across every remaining fault configuration, including simultaneous faults. Prospective correction is distinct from completed work.
app.source:
# Canonical Decision Lab data. Rules are data, never executable code.
format: complete-a-commitment/1
module:
  id: review-gift-kit-resolution-planning
  version: "3.0.0"
  title: Prepare gift kits before commitment
  template:
    id: complete-a-commitment
    version: 1
  question: "Which complete correction package addresses every remaining explanation and can finish before we commit the gift kits?"
  description: "Compare one authored correction package across every remaining fault configuration, including simultaneous faults. Prospective correction is distinct from completed work."
  metadata:
    catalog:
      domain:
        id: gifting-operations
        label: Gifting operations
      useCase:
        id: prepare-gift-kit-campaign
        label: Prepare a gift-kit campaign
    gifting:
      profileId: gift-kit-readiness
      profileVersion: "1.0.0"
      packages:
        - id: rehearse-unchanged
          label: "Prepare, rehearse and hand off unchanged kits"
          corrects: []
          requiresConfirmation: false
        - id: reprint
          label: Replace the printed inserts
          corrects: [replace-insert]
          requiresConfirmation: false
        - id: repair-journey
          label: Correct the destination and checkout
          corrects: [correct-destination, fix-checkout]
          requiresConfirmation: false
        - id: replace-and-repair
          label: Replace inserts and repair the journey
          corrects: [replace-insert, correct-destination, fix-checkout]
          requiresConfirmation: false
        - id: external-replace-and-repair
          label: External replacement and journey repair
          corrects: [replace-insert, correct-destination, fix-checkout]
          requiresConfirmation: true
      checks:
        - id: declared-fault-state
          requirement: COVERAGE
          label: Use an admitted configuration from the published fault catalog
          evidence: A current scoped evidence assessment admitting this fault configuration.
        - id: published-package-effects
          requirement: COVERAGE
          label: Retain the published correction effects of the selected package
          evidence: The author-fixed correction effects from this exact published package version.
        - id: correct-fault-0
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Address The printed code cannot be read whenever it remains possible
          evidence: "A complete package addressing The printed code cannot be read, or scoped evidence excluding that fault."
        - id: correct-fault-1
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Address The code leads to the wrong destination whenever it remains possible
          evidence: "A complete package addressing The code leads to the wrong destination, or scoped evidence excluding that fault."
        - id: correct-fault-2
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Address The intended checkout is restricted whenever it remains possible
          evidence: "A complete package addressing The intended checkout is restricted, or scoped evidence excluding that fault."
        - id: known-owner
          requirement: ACCESS
          label: Assign the complete work to a recorded responsible person
          evidence: A recorded person responsible for this complete correction package.
        - id: scoped-package-permission
          requirement: ACCESS
          label: "Hold recorded authority for this package, person, exact configuration, and whole working interval"
          evidence: "A sourced permission for the selected package and person, matching all six scope fields and covering correction through handoff."
        - id: resource-calendar
          requirement: ACCESS
          label: "Keep the full correction, rehearsal, and handoff within resource availability"
          evidence: An availability interval covering the complete proposed work.
        - id: resource-capacity
          requirement: ACCESS
          label: Keep all proposed work within recorded resource capacity
          evidence: Enough recorded resource capacity throughout the proposed work.
        - id: not-in-past
          requirement: TIME
          label: Start correction at or after the current review time
          evidence: A current proposed start time.
        - id: handoff-by-cutoff
          requirement: TIME
          label: "Finish correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff before the kit commitment cutoff"
          evidence: "Durations and resource availability that fit the cutoff, or a revised commitment."
        - id: package-within-budget
          requirement: COST
          label: Keep the complete proposed package within the recorded spending ceiling
          evidence: "A current package quote within the spending ceiling, or an approved revised ceiling."
        - id: quoted-quantity
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Use a complete-package quote for the current kit quantity
          evidence: A current complete-package quote and duration explicitly covering the stated kit quantity.
        - id: minimum-rehearsal
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Allow at least the published minimum duration for the scoped rehearsal
          evidence: "A proposed scoped rehearsal duration meeting the published minimum. This remains a plan, not evidence that rehearsal passed."
        - id: scoped-package-confirmation
          requirement: CONFIRMATION
          label: Confirm the selected arrangement for this exact gift-kit configuration
          evidence: "A sourced positive package confirmation, recorded by a named person, for this exact batch, insert, destination, checkout, device and account, effective at the planned start and valid through handoff."
  units:
    time: minute
    timeOrigin: Start of this gift-kit preparation review
    money: USD cent
    count: unit of resource capacity
    quantity: gift kit
  assumptions: ["The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.", One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration., Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge., "The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.", "The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.", "Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.", An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.]
  inputs:
    parameters:
      batchId:
        type: string
      insertRevision:

        unit: time

            minimum: 1

            unit: time
            minimum: 1

            unit: money
            minimum: 0

            type: boolean
      scenarios:

          fault1:
            type: boolean
          fault2:
            type: boolean
      people:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string

            type: string
          role:
            type: string
      permissions:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          batchId:
            type: string
          insertRevision:
            type: string
          destinationRevision:
            type: string
          checkoutRevision:
            type: string
          deviceScope:
            type: string
          accountScope:
            type: string
          id:
            type: string
          packageId:
            type: string
          actorId:
            type: string
          validFrom:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          validThrough:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          source:
            type: string
      resources:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          capacity:
            type: integer
            unit: count
            minimum: 0
      calendars:
        key: [resource, start, end]
        columns:
          resource:
            type: string
          start:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          end:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
      bookings:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          resource:
            type: string
          start:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          end:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          amount:
            type: integer
            unit: count
            minimum: 1
      confirmations:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          packageId:
            type: string
          batchId:
            type: string
          insertRevision:
            type: string
          destinationRevision:
            type: string
          checkoutRevision:
            type: string
          deviceScope:
            type: string
          accountScope:
            type: string
          confirmed:
            type: boolean
          validFrom:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          validThrough:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          recordedAt:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          source:
            type: string
          recordedBy:
            type: string
  choices:
    - id: packageId
      domain:
        values: [rehearse-unchanged, reprint, repair-journey, replace-and-repair, external-replace-and-repair]
    - id: startMinute
      domain:
        parameter: startOptions
  scenarioDomain:
    table: scenarios
  derived: []
  activities:
    - id: correct
      actor:
        ref: parameter.actorId
      start:
        ref: choice.startMinute
      duration:
        op: lookup
        table: packages
        where:
          id:
            ref: choice.packageId
        column: repairMinutes
      resources:
        - resource:
            literal: production-team
          amount:
            literal: 1
    - id: rehearse
      actor:
        ref: parameter.actorId
      start:
        ref: activity.correct.end
      duration:
        ref: parameter.rehearsalMinutes
      resources:
        - resource:
            literal: production-team
          amount:
            literal: 1
    - id: handoff
      actor:
        ref: parameter.actorId
      start:
        ref: activity.rehearse.end
      duration:
        ref: parameter.handoffMinutes
      resources:
        - resource:
            literal: production-team
          amount:
            literal: 1
  resources:
    definitions:
      table: resources
      idColumn: id
      capacityColumn: capacity
    bookings:
      table: bookings
      resourceColumn: resource
      startColumn: start
      endColumn: end
      amountColumn: amount
  requirements:
    - id: SUFFICIENCY
      label: Complete correction
      meaning: The selected complete package addresses each fault in every remaining explanation.
      waivable: false
    - id: COVERAGE
      label: Remaining explanations
      meaning: Every scenario comes from the author-declared fault catalog and the engine checks the whole admitted relation.
      waivable: false
    - id: ACCESS
      label: "People, resources, and permissions"
      meaning: "The proposed work has a known owner, resource capacity and availability, and recorded exact-scope permission."
      waivable: false
    - id: TIME
      label: Commitment cutoff
      meaning: The complete prospective work fits between now and the kit commitment cutoff.
      waivable: false
    - id: COST
      label: Spending ceiling
      meaning: The complete package cost fits the recorded spending ceiling.
      waivable: false
    - id: CONFIRMATION
      label: Confirm the selected arrangement for this exact gift-kit configuration
      meaning: "For any author-designated package, retain a named, sourced positive confirmation matching its package and all six configuration fields, recorded by the current review time, effective when correction starts, and valid through handoff."
      waivable: false
  constraints:
    - id: declared-fault-state
      requirement: COVERAGE
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: or
        args:
          - op: and
            args:
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.id
                  - literal: none
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault0
                  - literal: false
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault1
                  - literal: false
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault2
                  - literal: false
          - op: and
            args:
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.id
                  - literal: print
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault0
                  - literal: true
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault1
                  - literal: false
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault2
                  - literal: false
          - op: and
            args:
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.id
                  - literal: destination
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault0
                  - literal: false
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault1
                  - literal: true
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault2
                  - literal: false
          - op: and
            args:
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.id
                  - literal: print-destination
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault0
                  - literal: true
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault1
                  - literal: true
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault2
                  - literal: false
          - op: and
            args:
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.id
                  - literal: checkout
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault0
                  - literal: false
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault1
                  - literal: false
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault2
                  - literal: true
          - op: and
            args:
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.id
                  - literal: print-checkout
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault0
                  - literal: true
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault1
                  - literal: false
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault2
                  - literal: true
          - op: and
            args:

              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault1
                  - literal: true
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault2
                  - literal: true
          - op: and
            args:
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.id
                  - literal: print-destination-checkout
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault0
                  - literal: true
              - op: eq
                args:

                  - literal: true
              - op: eq

    - id: published-package-effects

              - op: eq

          - op: and

              - op: eq
                args:
                  - op: lookup
                    table: packages
                    where:

                        ref: choice.packageId

                  - op: lookup

                  - op: lookup

          - op: and
            args:

                args:
                  - ref: choice.packageId
                  - literal: replace-and-repair
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - op: lookup
                    table: packages
                    where:

                        ref: choice.packageId

                  - literal: true
              - op: eq
                args:

                      id:

                    column: fixes1
                  - literal: true

                  - op: lookup

                    where:
                      id:

                    column: fixes2
                  - literal: true
          - op: and
            args:

                  - ref: choice.packageId

                      id:
                        ref: choice.packageId

      kind: predicate
      predicate:

        args:
          - op: not
            args:
              - ref: scenario.fault0

            where:

                ref: choice.packageId

    - id: correct-fault-1

      predicate:

    - id: correct-fault-2

              - ref: scenario.fault2

            where:

    - id: known-owner
      requirement: ACCESS
      kind: predicate
      predicate:

        table: people
        where:
          id:
            ref: parameter.actorId
        test:
          op: and
          args:
            - op: ne
              args:
                - ref: row.name
                - literal: ""
            - op: ne
              args:
                - ref: row.role
                - literal: ""
    - id: scoped-package-permission
      requirement: ACCESS
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: permissions
        where:
          batchId:
            ref: parameter.batchId
          insertRevision:
            ref: parameter.insertRevision
          destinationRevision:
            ref: parameter.destinationRevision
          checkoutRevision:
            ref: parameter.checkoutRevision
          deviceScope:
            ref: parameter.deviceScope
          accountScope:
            ref: parameter.accountScope
          packageId:
            ref: choice.packageId
          actorId:
            ref: parameter.actorId
        test:
          op: and
          args:
            - op: ne
              args:
                - ref: row.source
                - literal: ""
            - op: lte
              args:
                - ref: row.validFrom
                - ref: activity.correct.start
            - op: gte
              args:
                - ref: row.validThrough
                - ref: activity.handoff.end
    - id: resource-calendar
      requirement: ACCESS
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: interval-covered
        table: calendars
        where:
          resource:
            literal: production-team
        start:
          ref: activity.correct.start
        end:
          ref: activity.handoff.end
        startColumn: start
        endColumn: end
    - id: resource-capacity
      requirement: ACCESS
      kind: resource-capacity
    - id: not-in-past
      requirement: TIME
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: gte
        args:
          - ref: activity.correct.start
          - ref: parameter.nowMinute
    - id: handoff-by-cutoff

      kind: predicate
      predicate:

        args:

    - id: package-within-budget
      requirement: COST
      kind: predicate
      predicate:

        args:

          - ref: parameter.budgetMinor
    - id: quoted-quantity
      requirement: SUFFICIENCY
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: eq
        args:
          - op: lookup
            table: packages
            where:
              id:
                ref: choice.packageId
            column: quantity
          - ref: parameter.quantity
    - id: minimum-rehearsal
      requirement: SUFFICIENCY
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: gte
        args:
          - ref: parameter.rehearsalMinutes
          - literal: 5
    - id: scoped-package-confirmation
      requirement: CONFIRMATION
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: or
        args:
          - literal: false
          - op: not
            args:
              - op: in
                args:
                  - ref: choice.packageId
                  - literal: [external-replace-and-repair]
          - op: exists
            table: confirmations
            where:
              packageId:
                ref: choice.packageId
              batchId:
                ref: parameter.batchId
              insertRevision:
                ref: parameter.insertRevision
              destinationRevision:
                ref: parameter.destinationRevision
              checkoutRevision:
                ref: parameter.checkoutRevision
              deviceScope:
                ref: parameter.deviceScope
              accountScope:
                ref: parameter.accountScope
            test:
              op: and
              args:
                - op: eq
                  args:
                    - ref: row.confirmed
                    - literal: true
                - op: ne
                  args:
                    - ref: row.source
                    - literal: ""
                - op: ne
                  args:
                    - ref: row.recordedBy
                    - literal: ""
                - op: lte
                  args:
                    - ref: row.recordedAt
                    - ref: parameter.nowMinute
                - op: lte
                  args:
                    - ref: row.validFrom
                    - ref: activity.correct.start
                - op: gte
                  args:
                    - ref: row.validThrough
                    - ref: activity.handoff.end
  finance:
    mode: expense
    charges:
      - id: complete-correction-package
        amount:
          op: lookup
          table: packages
          where:
            id:
              ref: choice.packageId
          column: repairCostMinor
    holds: []
  preference:
    direction: min
    expression:
      ref: finance.expense
    then:
      - direction: min
        expression:
          ref: activity.handoff.end
  labels:

    actor: Responsible person
    expense: Complete package cost
    choice.packageId: Preparation or correction package
    choice.startMinute: Proposed start minute
    activity.correct: Prepare or correct the gift-kit arrangement
    activity.rehearse: Repeat the scoped gift journey rehearsal
    activity.handoff: Prepare and complete the kit handoff
    constraint.declared-fault-state: Use an admitted configuration from the published fault catalog
    constraint.published-package-effects: Retain the published correction effects of the selected package
    constraint.correct-fault-0: Address The printed code cannot be read whenever it remains possible
    constraint.correct-fault-1: Address The code leads to the wrong destination whenever it remains possible

definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

assumptions: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

record:basis.title: Accepted basis and assumptions
record:basis.question: Which accepted inputs and assumptions bound this completion claim?

blocks.text: Compare one authored correction package across every remaining fault configuration, including simultaneous faults. Prospective correction is distinct from completed work.

The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

nodes: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

units.timeOrigin: Start of this gift-kit preparation review

assumptions: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

requirements.label: Complete correction
requirements.meaning: The selected complete package addresses each fault in every remaining explanation.

requirements.label: Remaining explanations
requirements.meaning: Every scenario comes from the author-declared fault catalog and the engine checks the whole admitted relation.

requirements.label: People, resources, and permissions
requirements.meaning: The proposed work has a known owner, resource capacity and availability, and recorded exact-scope permission.

requirements.label: Commitment cutoff
requirements.meaning: The complete prospective work fits between now and the kit commitment cutoff.

requirements.label: Spending ceiling
requirements.meaning: The complete package cost fits the recorded spending ceiling.

requirements.label: Confirm the selected arrangement for this exact gift-kit configuration
requirements.meaning: For any author-designated package, retain a named, sourced positive confirmation matching its package and all six configuration fields, recorded by the current review time, effective when correction starts, and valid through handoff.

record:basis.title: Accepted basis and assumptions
record:basis.question: Which accepted inputs and assumptions bound this completion claim?

blocks.text: Compare one authored correction package across every remaining fault configuration, including simultaneous faults. Prospective correction is distinct from completed work.

The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

nodes: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

units.timeOrigin: Start of this gift-kit preparation review

assumptions: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.

blocks.text: Compare one authored correction package across every remaining fault configuration, including simultaneous faults. Prospective correction is distinct from completed work.

The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

nodes: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.
The printed insert cannot be decoded on the declared test phone.
The source artwork names the wrong destination.
The intended account completed the checkout check.

assumptions: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

blocks.text: Compare one authored correction package across every remaining fault configuration, including simultaneous faults. Prospective correction is distinct from completed work.

The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.

nodes: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

nodes: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

record:basis.title: Accepted basis and assumptions
record:basis.question: Which accepted inputs and assumptions bound this completion claim?

blocks.text: Compare one authored correction package across every remaining fault configuration, including simultaneous faults. Prospective correction is distinct from completed work.

The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

nodes: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

nodes: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

record:basis.title: Accepted basis and assumptions
record:basis.question: Which accepted inputs and assumptions bound this completion claim?

blocks.text: Compare one authored correction package across every remaining fault configuration, including simultaneous faults. Prospective correction is distinct from completed work.

The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

blocks.text: Calculated feasibility is conditional on the accepted facts and assumptions. It does not grant permission, reserve capacity, or record actual completion.

record:changes.question: How did changed inputs alter the completion finding and preferred plan?

blocks.text: No previous evaluated input or archived calculation was supplied for comparison.
Changes describe calculations from explicitly accepted inputs. They do not establish a new operating fact or authorize execution.

nodes: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

nodes: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.
Start of this gift-kit preparation review
The selected complete package addresses each fault in every remaining explanation.
Every scenario comes from the author-declared fault catalog and the engine checks the whole admitted relation.
The proposed work has a known owner, resource capacity and availability, and recorded exact-scope permission.
The complete prospective work fits between now and the kit commitment cutoff.
The complete package cost fits the recorded spending ceiling.
